# McLaren P1 source status

The requested source is now supplied in `assets/cars/mclaren_p1/`, complete with `scene.gltf`,
`scene.bin`, textures and CC BY 4.0 license. It has been processed and visually tested.
**No manual download is pending in this workspace.**

Use the deterministic semantic-wheel pipeline and reproduction commands in
[assets/cars/README.md](../../cars/README.md). Runtime files are
`apps/dashboard/public/assets/mclaren-p1.glb` and `mclaren-p1.json`.
The old Blender/archive helpers remain as historical alternatives; the tested M5.5 path uses
NumPy/SciPy/Pillow and the installed Meshopt encoder without Blender.
